summary.text: Leader of the Danaans whom Hector slew after Asaeus when Zeus vouchsafed the prince glory — distinct from Autonous whom Patroclus laid low in the counter-rout of *Iliad* 16.

story.text: Hector, Priam's son, when Zeus vouchsafed him glory, first slew Asaeus and then Autonous among the leaders of the Danaans, and thereafter Opites, Dolops son of Clytius, Opheltius, Agelaus, and the rest of the foremost slain before he fell upon the multitude.
